plans.query: select "players"."season_id", "seasons"."starts_at", "seasons"."asteroid_key", "seasons"."tempo_starts_at" from "players" inner join "seasons" on "players"."season_id" = "seasons"."id" where "players"."account_id" = $1 limit $2

select "id", "season_id", "sequence", "kind", "definition_version", "starts_at", "ends_at", "effect", "start_processed_at", "end_processed_at", "created_at" from "galaxy_event_occurrences" where ("galaxy_event_occurrences"."season_id" = $1 and "galaxy_event_occurrences"."starts_at" <= $2 and "galaxy_event_occurrences"."ends_at" > $3) order by "galaxy_event_occurrences"."starts_at" asc, "galaxy_event_occurrences"."kind" asc, "galaxy_event_occurrences"."id" asc

Plans.Filter: ((starts_at <= '2026-10-25 21:54:46.546+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (ends_at > '2026-10-25 21:54:46.546+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (season_id = '<uuid>'::uuid))

plans.query: select "players"."season_id", "seasons"."ruleset_version", "seasons"."status" from "players" inner join "seasons" on "players"."season_id" = "seasons"."id" where "players"."account_id" = $1 limit $2

select "kind", "starts_at" from "galaxy_event_occurrences" where ("galaxy_event_occurrences"."season_id" = $1 and "galaxy_event_occurrences"."starts_at" > $2 and "galaxy_event_occurrences"."kind" in ($3, $4, $5)) order by "galaxy_event_occurrences"."starts_at" asc, "galaxy_event_occurrences"."kind" asc limit $6

select "hour_starts_at", "lanes", "level_weights", "generation" from "asteroid_spawn_hours" where ("asteroid_spawn_hours"."season_id" = $1 and "asteroid_spawn_hours"."hour_starts_at" >= $2) order by "asteroid_spawn_hours"."hour_starts_at"
